name: Gorilla Survival
summary: Welcome players! Gorilla Survival, based off the hit game "Gorilla Tag" as well as "Survive the Killer," offers a variety of different maps and challenges waiting for you! Become a runner, and escape or collect gun parts to defeat the killer. Or become the killer, and hunt down all runners. Collect XP from playing and level up your weapons! So, what are you waiting for? Dive into Gorilla Survival now!
